# The University of Texas at El Paso (UTEP)

> America's leading Hispanic-serving university offering comprehensive undergraduate and graduate programs with a focus on research, innovation, and first-generation student support.

UTEP is a major research university in El Paso, Texas, part of the UT System. The institution serves a diverse student population and emphasizes accessibility, academic excellence, and community engagement across multiple colleges including engineering, business, liberal arts, and education.

## Key Topics

- Hispanic-serving institution
- Undergraduate programs
- Graduate programs
- Research and innovation
- Admissions
- Financial aid
- First-generation students
- Student portal (MY UTEP)
- College of Engineering
- Woody L. Hunt College of Business
- College of Liberal Arts
- College of Education
- ApplyTexas
- Aerospace research
- Space Force partnership

## Admissions & Student Entry

- [Apply To The University of Texas at El Paso](https://www.utep.edu/resources/apply.html): Guide to applying to UTEP via ApplyTexas portal for all student types
- [Future Miners](https://www.utep.edu/student-affairs/admissions): UTEP admissions information for prospective undergraduate and graduate students
- [Inquire | UTEP](https://www.utep.edu/inquire): Information request form for prospective students about UTEP programs

## Academic Programs

- [Undergraduate](https://www.utep.edu/programs/undergraduate): Directory of UTEP undergraduate degree programs across all colleges
- [Graduate](https://www.utep.edu/programs/graduate): Directory of UTEP graduate and doctoral degree programs
- [Applied Arts and Science, BAAS](https://www.utep.edu/programs/online): UTEP online degree programs including BAAS and other flexible options

## Student & Faculty Resources

- [MY UTEP](https://my.utep.edu): Student and faculty portal for accessing university resources and services
- [Resources for Faculty and Staff](https://www.utep.edu/resources/faculty-and-staff.html): Hub for faculty and staff resources, directory, and administrative links

## Research & Innovation
